text: MenuzKit has one formatter for the identity row, Identity.line(version:commit:tree:kind:), pure: it renders 'menuz <version> (<commit>)', puts 'dirty-' before the commit when the source-tree stamp ends -dirty, adds ' dev' after the parentheses unless the kind is 'release', and renders a stamp absent from the plist as 'unknown'; MenuzKitTests covers every form.
